title: かごめかごめ (Kagome Kagome)
description: A mysterious Edo-period circle game song in which one child sits blindfolded in the center while others circle and sing. When the song ends, the center child must guess who stands directly behind them. The cryptic lyrics — cranes, turtles, and the paradox of 'the night of dawn' — have no agreed interpretation.
license: Public Domain (Traditional Japanese warabe-uta, Edo period)
